review.reason: The mapped layout, hazards, walking connectors, tees, greens, and striped fairways are otherwise depicted faithfully. Hole 3’s approach is visually crowded by added trees near the fairway end and green.

issues.detail: Trees and their crowns occupy the rough corridor between the lower-left striped fairway and G3, crowding the approach.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the approach to G3 appear obstructed by vegetation.
